title: RentBuild | C4 Containers — TB1 and AV2
note: TB1 USES THE DEMO API. THE ASP.NET CORE API AND MYSQL ARE AV2 PROPOSALS.

nodes.title: Rental Operator / Construction Manager
nodes.body:
[Person]
Browses public content and uses role-appropriate application views.

nodes.title: Landing Page — TB1
nodes.body:
[Container: HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript]
Public information, translations and configured app links.

nodes.title: Web Application — TB1
nodes.body:
[Container: Vue 3 / JavaScript / Vite]
PrimeVue 4, Vue Router, Pinia; Axios + RxJS requests. Demo session.

nodes.title: Demo API — TB1
nodes.body:
[Container: Node.js / json-server 0.17]
Illustrative authentication and JSON resources. Resettable demo data.

nodes.title: RESTful API — proposed AV2
nodes.body:
[Container: ASP.NET Core / C# / EF Core]
Server authorization, use cases, persistence and OpenAPI/Swagger.

nodes.title: Relational Database — proposed AV2
nodes.body:
[Container: MySQL]
Persistent owned tables, keys and constraints. EF Core runs in the API.
